adminFirebase.title: Firebase Push Notifications
adminFirebase.subtitle: Configure Firebase Cloud Messaging to send push notifications to mobile and web clients.
adminFirebase.cardSubtitle: Send push notifications to Android, iOS, and web clients via FCM.
adminFirebase.vapidKeyPlaceholder: BNxxxxxx… (Firebase Console → Project Settings → Cloud Messaging)
adminFirebase.keyNeverExposed: Private key is never returned in full.
adminFirebase.guide1Body: Go to console.firebase.google.com and create a new project (or use an existing one).
adminFirebase.guide2Body: Project Settings → Service Accounts → Generate new private key. Download the JSON file.
adminFirebase.guide3Body: From the JSON: copy "project_id", "client_email", and "private_key" into the Server Credentials section.
adminFirebase.guide4Body: Project Settings → General → Your apps → SDK setup → Config. Copy all fields into the Client SDK Config section.
adminFirebase.guide5Body: Project Settings → Cloud Messaging → Web configuration → Generate key pair → copy into VAPID Key.
adminFirebase.guide6Body: Toggle the switch to Enabled, fill in all fields, and click Save All Settings.
adminFirebase.what1: Server sends FCM push via Admin SDK (server credentials)
adminFirebase.what4: Private key is masked in the UI and never exposed
adminFirebase.confirmEnableDesc: Firebase Cloud Messaging will be used for push notifications.
adminFirebase.confirmDisableDesc: Push notifications will stop being sent until Firebase is re-enabled.
